answers.core: The implemented solution adjusts the default graphics and fixes an alignment issue in the 3D editor. The changes are very light.
answers.workaround:
Providing a different graphic for the grabber can solve the case, but this solution has a lower discoverability. 

For the editor, a theme override can work, but the generation of corresponding assets based on the defined theme colors is lost.

title: Remove 8px minimum thickness of SplitContainer drag bars in the default themes
